newsitem.title: FRANCE: Parliament to hear C.Lyonnais head March.
newsitem.headline: Parliament to hear C.Lyonnais head March.

text.p: Crdit Lyonnais chairman Jean Peyrelevade will be heard on Tuesday afternoon by the National Assembly's finance committee, parliament sources said.
Last week finance committee member Patrick Devedjian put at about 130 billion francs the total cost of putting Credit Lyonnais back on its feet.
Michel Rouger, president of the Consortium de Realisation (CDR), the body in charge of selling the doubtful assets of Credit Lyonnais, will be heard by the same committee on Wednesday.
